name: source-file-links
goal: Source lists actual files with revision-pinned GitHub links and a modal button for each file

evidence: Source tab must list concrete files only, linking each to the selected GitHub commit and opening that file in the shared modal. Feature specification updated.

Existing Reports entity-preview-source and Desktop entity-source-code scenarios asserted one entity action and accepted metadata. Strengthened those scenarios and snapshot fixtures with per-file links, encoded paths, directory ownership and direct second-file opening.
